When Ye Qing was 19, he harbored a secret crush on his tutor. 18 years later, the feelings he had been hiding were discovered by his tutor’s son. In the Nine Skies Continent, during the era of the Dharma's decline, the spiritual energy between heaven and earth has become scarce, and precious treasures are now rare. For ordinary people aspiring to step into the path of martial arts and become esteemed warriors, it is as difficult as reaching the heavens, let alone reaching the pinnacle of martial arts—the realm of the Saints.

In this time of turmoil, the Dark Star descends, and the dark seeds run rampant, mercilessly slaughtering cities and annihilating nations, while the human race struggles to survive. Against this backdrop, numerous sects and factions vie for limited resources, engaging in relentless conflicts and leaving the land filled with cries of despair.

Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge.

biography.en:
She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.

description.en:
The man whom she used to be so passionately in love with so many years ago suddenly disappears, only to appear right before her eyes once more. What should Lin Shan Shan do? Interrogate him? Ignore him? Pretend that nothing ever happened?   
Unfortunately, Lin Shan Shan is unable to do any of those. Despite it all, she could never erase the man before her from her heart. Yet, when he had reappeared in front of her once again, he's already the father of a daughter. All of those times where she had imagined their reunion have all suddenly turned into a sour joke that she keeps locked within her heart.

The world has become gamified, and people are forced into a game belonging to the gods. On Blue Star, an existence known as the “Void Abyss” appeared. Powerful guilds monopolize the upgrade materials, and top-tier players are revered as “Authority Players.” Players across the globe watch every challenge made against the Void Abyss’s lower floors, hoping to unearth the secret hidden at its very lowest level.

Lin Du, history’s first person to break through the 100th floor of the Void Abyss, was — just as he was about to claim his reward — personally pushed to the brink of death by his own most trusted vice-captain. As he lay on the verge of death, an existence claiming to be a “god” forced him to sign a contract.

A hundred years later, Lin Du awakens in the shallow floors of the Void Abyss. His reconstructed body is detected as being only Level ‘0’ — a weakling. The tactics he once formulated have become textbook material, the teammate who betrayed him is now revered as the world’s savior, and the truth has long since been buried.

As a prisoner of war, the Heavenly Wolf had a frivolous attitude and no remorse, leaving the beautiful General to feel disdainful! The Heavenly Wolf originally wanted to teach the General a lesson, but was captured by his beauty and gave him a bite mark?! Como prisionero de guerra, el Lobo Celestial tenía una actitud frívola y sin remordimientos, ¡haciendo que el hermoso General Shen se enojara!

El Lobo Celestial originalmente quería enseñar al General Shen una lección, pero, ¡¿fue capturado por su belleza y lo marcó?! Para el bien del pueblo, el General Shen no tuvo más remedio que mantener al prisionero a su lado... description.en:
The story takes place on Earth nearly a thousand years in the future. After a devastating war between artificial intelligence and humanity, monstrous creatures known as "Tai Sui" roam the land, drastically altering the natural environment and social order. In response, humanity developed "BOX"—a series of advanced technologies related to mysterious boxes. These "Beast Boxes" became humanity's key allies in the fierce resistance against their enemies.

Elites capable of "resonating" with their Beast Box partners are known as "Beast Box Masters." Among them, a once-overlooked Beast Box Master named Liu Ma is unexpectedly chosen by a small dinosaur-like Beast Box named "Dio." Together, they begin their mission to protect the city-state. During grueling training, Liu Ma meets several other Beast Box Masters and their Beast Box companions. The group is soon tasked with reinforcing "Vermilion City," marking the beginning of their epic journey.

The story takes place in China during the Ming Dynasty. It revolves around the two expert pugilists, Wind and Cloud. They learn martial arts and move up to become legendary figures in the jianghu (martial artists' community). description.es:
Après des années d'étude de la médecine en Europe, Guan Lan revient chez lui.  
Voulant surprendre sa famille, il entre par la porte de derrière et tombe sur une magnifique femme souffrant d'une insolation.  
Voulant la soigner il se rencontre que c'est un homme et que c'est la quatrième épouse de son père.  
Intrigué par le jeune homme, saura-t-il voir plus loin que le maquillage et les racontards des autres épouses de son père ?

Within the span of one day, she was trailed by a strange teenager and threatened by a mysterious individual clad in black. As a result, she became involved in the battle for a hidden treasure. Surrounded by enemies, Jiang Jun formed an alliance with Shen Cang Lan. What other mysteries will this dynamic duo uncover as they approach the truth behind the hidden treasure?

Yun Yang is the central figure of the Nine Supremes of Yutang, heroes of the world. When the Nine supremes were ambushed and killed at Tianxuan Cliff, Yun Yang was the only one to escape the massacre albeit with heavy internal injuries. Watch as he takes revenge for his brothers against all those involved.

description.en: Adapted from a novel. This is a story of a young man who could not practice martial arts due to a disease. In fact, he was not expected to live past the ag of twenty-five. He would quickly vanish into obscurity and return to the capital in a decade. At night, he removes his disguise and puts on a white armor, just who is this man that has transformed into Whitebone in the night…?

description.en:
After she was nearly killed and then rescued, Ruan Ruan lost all her memories. Her savior, Ding Xiao, treated her with all the tenderness in the world; she completely let her guard down in the face of his perfect image. After figuring out the identity of her attacker, Ruan Ruan naively thought they were heading toward a happy ending. However, after discovering Ding Xiao's secret, her world turned upside down! With danger looming on all sides, will she continue to be the prey, or will she become the hunter?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
description.es-la: Después de ser casi asesinada y después salvada, Ruan Ruan perdió todos sus recuerdos. Su salvador, Ding Xiao, la trató con toda la amabilidad del mundo; ella bajó la guardia totalmente debido a su imagen perfecta. Después de descubrir la identidad de su atacante, Ruan Ruan ingenuamente pensó que se estaban acercando a un final feliz. Sin embargo, tras descubrir el secreto de Ding Xiao, ¡su mundo dio un giro! Con el peligro asechando en todos lados, ¿seguirá siendo la presa, o se convertirá en el cazador?
